newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on easing liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on easing liquidity.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished lower on Monday as routine monthly payrolls which flowed out of the banking system in recent weeks continued to return to the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.988 percent against Saturday's 5.006 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.05-5.10 against 5.20.
Dealers expected the rates to fall further on Tuesday.
The bond market was quiet in afternoon trade due to a lack of market-moving factors.
Dealers said they expected the market to stay in a consolidation before a scheduled bond auction on Friday.
